Overview.Name: Mukkanteswararao
Overview.Food_Habit: I can eat one bite and stop
Overview.Preference_Notes: Results first – include non-veg as needed

Meal_1_Lunch: Option 1: Cooked rice (1 cup cooked ~150 g) + chicken curry (small portion) + vegetable curry
Option 2: Cooked rice (3/4 cup cooked ~110 g) + fish curry + vegetable curry
Option 3: Cooked rice (3/4 cup cooked ~110 g) + egg curry (2–3 eggs)
Meal_2_Dinner: Option 1: Cooked rice (1/2 cup cooked ~75 g) + chicken curry (small portion)
Option 2: Egg omelette (2 eggs) + cucumber salad
Option 3: Thick curd bowl + vegetable curry (lightest option)

Notes_and_Tips: Since you eat 2 meals per day, make sure both meals contain strong protein.
Start lunch and dinner with chicken, fish or eggs before eating rice.
Keep dinner lighter than lunch for better digestion and sleep.
Avoid very spicy outside food even if cravings are high.
Consistent meal timing supports better mood and stress control.
